summary: Frontend-only landing page for eXceeders fully verified. Home page renders all 8 sections (Hero, TrustedBy, WhyChoose, WaysWeHelp, WhyOurModel, Network, WhoElse, FinalCTA), sticky header with 6 nav links + active indicator dot, footer with all links/socials/legal, and network SVG diagram animate correctly. All 5 service routes (/cio-plus, /talent-plus, /support-plus, /dev-plus, /project-plus) render the 'Page Coming Soon' state with Back-to-Home + Notify buttons and shared header/footer. Ways-We-Help correctly renders only 4 service cards (Project Plus excluded per spec). Animated counters reach expected end values (30/90/99, 600/100K/1,000). All 4 'Book a Free Consultation' CTAs (header, mobile, hero implicit, final, footer) are dead placeholders and do NOT navigate away. Mobile drawer opens/closes correctly on <1024px viewport and closes on navigation. No horizontal overflow at 1920, 1280, 768, 375 widths. After a small SVG fix, page loads with 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: NetworkDiagram had a benign but noisy issue: motion.circle animating the SVG `r` attribute rendered `r=undefined` for the very first frame, producing 7 console errors per page load. Fixed by adding `initial={{ r: n.r, opacity: 0.25 }}` to the pulsing hub circle. Console is now clean.
All required data-testid attributes are present and stable — good testability.
Home.jsx composition is clean and each section is a self-contained module — good separation of concerns.
Footer contact fields are intentional italic placeholders (email/phone/address) per user choice — verified as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page is stable. If additional service pages are wired up later (replacing ComingSoon), re-verify: (1) active nav indicator moves accordingly, (2) header/footer still render, (3) no new console errors. The Book-a-Consultation buttons are still intentional dead placeholders per user choice — do not flag them as broken.
